text:
Nora (SI PM): FYI customer ran the preflight and hit a hard block on the final-mile. App never binds, 502 from ALB. Need a live handoff to their network team, they say port 8443 is blocked. cc @Raj Patel :phone:

Raj Patel: On it. Can you paste the preflight log and the exact test command they ran? I’ll ping their netops.

Nora (SI PM): They used our quick-check script from the marketplace guide: `./check_connect.sh https://edge.partner.example.com:8443`. Log excerpt:
```
[preflight] tcp connect to edge.partner.example.com:8443 timed out after 10s
[preflight] certificate chain ok
[preflight] agent failed to register: 502 Bad Gateway
```

Elaine Wong: 8443 is our default edge port but some gov clouds block it. Two quick options: ask them to allow 8443 from our egress CIDR, or flip to 9443 (we support it) and update the ALB listener. If they need a short-term workaround, we can enable proxy fallback.

Samir Khan: +1 to Elaine. If ops won't open firewall we can switch listeners. Steps I usually run on customer infra:
```
# on their ALB/NLB
add-listener --port 9443 --target-group tg-redwood-edge
# update security group
allow tcp 9443 from 52.18.0.0/16
```

Nora (SI PM): Their security team is very change-averse. They want a runbook we can hand to the field engineer to minimize approvals. Can you draft the minimal change set? Also they asked for an architecture review call today at 4pm PT.

Raj Patel: I’ll assemble a 1-page runbook with rollback steps. Draft checklist:
- Confirm egress CIDR + port (8443/9443)
- If open: run `./check_connect.sh` -> expect 200
- If blocked: add listener 9443 + SG rule, test, then schedule ALB cutover
- Rollback: revert listener + remove SG rule

Raj Patel: Also starting a quick bridge with their netops (in email) — request to expedite TTL on security approvals.

Samir Khan: For the architecture call, here's the mini diagram to share: https://redwood.example.com/partner/diagrams/final-mile-edge-v1 (short link to our kit). Keep it focused: ports, TLS SNI, cert pinning, and health-check path `/v1/health` (they blocked `/healthz` previously).

Elaine Wong: Quick config snippet for proxy fallback (send to field):
```
edge:
  listener_port: 8443
  fallback_proxy: http://internal-proxy.local:8080
  fallback_path: /proxy-edge
```
Note: fallback adds ~40ms latency but avoids infra changes.

Nora (SI PM): Great. I’ll book 4pm PT architecture review and include Raj/Samir/FieldEng. Sending the runbook to their security lead now.

deploy-bot: Deployment status: canary -> failed (image pull) — unrelated but FYI :warning:  
Samir Khan: Noted on deploy-bot. Field engineer asked if we can do a remote session to apply listener temporarily; prefer Zoom + screen share, 30m. Nora, can you confirm time window with customer?

Nora (SI PM): Confirmed 4:30–5:00 PT for remote session after 4pm review. I'll post dial-in and join links.

Raj Patel: Runbook draft uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/partner/onprem-checklist. Tagging @Samir to review step 3 (ALB commands).

Nora (SI PM): Thanks — team, please react with :thumbsup: once you reviewed. Closing loop after the 4pm call and posting outcome here.
